_comment: Hierarchical AllGather on TwoPodRailHostBound -- the SAME graph as two_pod_rail_hierarchical_allgather.json with GPU_LEAF_BW lowered from 50 to 25 GB/s. That moves the binding cut from the spine layer onto the GPU->leaf link, which is the RATE configuration: both streams on that link are pinned with zero slack, so a rate-oblivious emitter cannot hide in headroom. Run it as an A/B against the multipath config.
_log_file: A SUFFIX on the auto-generated Gurobi log name, not a path (see the multipath input for the full naming rule). Set here specifically to read back WHICH algorithm ran and whether crossover happened -- the open question behind method=1/crossover=1 above.
_solver_settings: method=1 (dual simplex) and crossover=1 are LOAD-BEARING here, not tuning. Saturating every host uplink in every epoch imposes 224 tight equalities, and LEXICOGRAPHIC tier 1 sums FRACTIONAL demand satisfied so it cannot rank the enormous family of compositions that satisfy them. Left on the barrier default the solver returns that degenerate face's analytic center -- 83 distinct smeared volumes, most off reconstruct.MAX_DENOM = 64 -- and the identity snap rejects them (job 1498195). A basic/vertex solution has minimal support and lands on the natural grid.
_expected: Coarse level, VERIFIED on job 1498195: 7 epochs / 0.28 s, which is exactly the bound (8 hosts x 7 chunks = 56 sends over 8 chunks/epoch of aggregate host egress); all 224 host-uplink link-epochs at 100%; zero host relay; spine cut carrying exactly its 32-chunk minimum. Fine level: T* = 0.56 s at chunk_size 1 GB, per-GPU cross-pod 14.29 + intra-pod 10.71 = 25.00 = exactly line rate. The trade: the leaf uplink runs at 76%, so the 2:1 spine split is not the unique optimum here (ECMP loses by only 1.14x vs 1.50x in the multipath config) -- rest a multipath claim on that config, not this one.
